summary: 56-year-old man lost at the base of Flattop Mountain in the Bear Lake area on Monday evening; rangers contacted him by cell phone and advised him to keep moving east; his phone battery then died; other hikers found him the next morning and rangers reached them ~90 min later
location: Base of Flattop Mountain, Bear Lake area, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: One of three SAR operations reported Tue/Thu Jun 27-30, 2011. Date = the Monday-evening call per the report; weekday-verified.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Flattop Mountain)
